title: Miagao barangay directory and linked public records

sources.mpbProjectRecords: BetterGov FY2015–FY2027 multi-purpose-building map line export. FY2015–FY2026 rows use listed GAA allocations; FY2027 rows use House Bill allocations. Barangay assignments use the export PSGC code and stated place basis (title or GPS); rows assigned only to broader administrative levels or no place are excluded from barangay rankings.
sources.barangayOfficialsRosterNote: The municipal roster page announces the 2023 elected officials but its linked media are photos, not a machine-readable name roster. Individual 2018 barangay profile names are excluded from the current captain field.
sources.barangayProfilesNote: The municipal barangay profiles are older background records (profile entries dated 2018); service, infrastructure, and official details may be outdated.

matchingNote: Project title mentions are leads to public records, not geocoded site boundaries. Shared/corridor projects can be listed for multiple barangays; do not sum per-barangay amounts as a municipality total.
